newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bulls run Madrid stocks to fresh closing high.
newsitem.headline: Bulls run Madrid stocks to fresh closing high.

text.p: Madrid stocks powered ahead to set fresh closing highs on Wednesday, as banks and hypermarkets bolstered indices after positive economic data, dealers said.
The general index rose 9.65 points, 1.63 percent, to 601.73 and the Ibex added 116.09 points, 1.71 percent, to 6,913.17.
Banks in particular were strong, with yet more progress expected, according to analysts. BBV gained 2.39 percent, Popular rose 3.0 percent and Santander added 2.58 percent.
Hypermarkets rocketed on first quarter GDP data showing a sharp rise in private consumption. Pryca added 6.98 percent and Continente rose 8.49 percent.
Also in focus was steel tubing-maker Tubacex, due to enter the Ibex from July, and up 12.8 percent to 526 pesetas. Some dealers warned however that the shares may now be overpriced.
Spanish GDP, which was up 2.9 percent year-on-year in the first quarter, were welcomed, especially since the data come after fresh lows in inflation, one dealer explained.
Positive references abroad, plus expectations of further inflows to the bourse next week when a special government debt issue matures were also behind buying, dealers said.
Most expect consolidation before the rally continues.
